Official NOA Attica HTML catalog lists three distinct Penteli cameras: dome, SW Athens, Parnitha-facing. Same owner-rights notice.
Official meteo.gr About page identifies National Observatory of Athens source/operator.
Reproduction of site information requires NOA consent and source attribution; no accuracy/continuity guarantee.
Municipal homepage advertises watching Kos from 10 spots, not independently established camera count.
Municipal camera page lists Main Port of Kos 1 and 2; one visible YouTube iframe pointer. No player fetched.
Municipal English Terms of Use page returns title/shell and all-rights-reserved footer; no substantive media reuse grant found.
Resort page names camera tabs, chalet 1700m and park 1860m. Weather text 19/4/2026 despite HTTP modification 13 Nov 2026. All-rights-reserved footer.
Marmari harbor description; published map URL xlat=38.049314 xlon=24.317190. Informational/weather-only notice and no intentional personal-data processing. Capture unknown.
Schinias Fire Cam label; published map URL xlat=38.157 xlon=24.00747, historical Mati weather text 23/7/2018. No current fire, thermal or detection proof.
Official Windy documentation embeds OpenAPI 3.0.0; documented list/detail endpoints require x-windy-api-key. No API invoked.
API usage requires supplied image URLs, linked source/player and Windy courtesy; full terms linked.
429 on bounded follow-up of full Windy public terms after earlier 200 GC-E14A. Stopped, no retry/bypass.
mykosmos.gr network catalog; individual owners retain camera rights; publisher says no image/video/timelapse archive.
